title: Echoes
description:
Plunge into Greenhearth, a small town hiding heavy secrets: take on the role of Ricky Fox and lead an investigation that gradually shifts from an intimate film noir into oppressive Lovecraftian horror. Driven by memorable characters and revelations that will linger long after the credits roll, Echoes delivers a taut narrative where every discovery matters and leads to four distinct endings shaped by your choices.

But hurry — it may already be too late…

• Search scenes rich with clues, confront mysterious witnesses, and steer the investigation as you wish.

• A simple point-and-click system that reinforces the detective feel and pushes you to become the protagonist of the story.

• Every decision alters relationships, opening or closing leads and triggering tangible consequences.

• True replayability: explore different paths to reveal the full extent of the mystery, with multiple possible endings depending on your choices.

• Hand-painted illustrations that evolve with the narrative: from soft grayscale to stark black & white, culminating in a breathtaking Technicolor finale.

• Minimalist, effective sound design that enhances the game’s intimate, cinematic atmosphere.

• A gallery of eccentric characters, from a tough-as-nails sheriff to a neurotic waitress, making every playthrough unique.

• Play the story with a friend via Remote Play Together to share all the emotions of this dark, horrific investigation.
description_short: Echoes is a 2D narrative game where you play as Ricky Fox, a detective haunted by the death of his best friend, Arthur. Step into Greenhearth, a small town full of secrets, and make choices that will shape your investigation. Will you crack the case with your sanity intact?
